# AWS Amplify Hosting

Store Hosting apps, branches, jobs, domain associations, webhooks and backend environment metadata without builds, deployments or DNS.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `amplify` |
| Signing name | `amplify` |
| Wire protocol | REST JSON |
| API version | `2017-07-25` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Records only |
| Selected operations | 34 of 37 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#aws-amplify-hosting) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No build runner, hosting, artifact uploads/downloads, repository authentication, external webhooks, metrics, access logs, real DNS, certificates or automatic branch/subdomain creation; configuration flags only record intent.
- Jobs never succeed or execute: clients waiting for build/deployment completion will continue waiting; domain waiters likewise never observe AVAILABLE.
- GenerateAccessLogs, GetArtifactUrl and ListArtifacts are not implemented.
- Zip upload URLs, per-file upload URLs and webhook URLs are inert and cannot receive uploads or trigger jobs.
- StartJob MANUAL and WEB_HOOK are rejected; manual jobs use StartDeployment. StartDeployment requires exactly one of jobId and sourceUrl and rejects re-starting a deployment. RETRY commit overrides are rejected explicitly.
- CloudFormation AutoBranchCreationConfig, AWS::Amplify::Webhook and AWS::Amplify::Jobs are not registered; removing non-tag properties during an in-place update is rejected explicitly.
- CloudFormation domain completion means the record exists, not DNS verification; the underlying domain remains PENDING_VERIFICATION.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
